automated_review.onboarding: Before opening a non-trivial PR, freeze a commit SHA and obtain a PASS or CHANGES_REQUESTED verdict from a separate read-only Codex reviewer who did not implement the change. P0/P1 findings block integration and every changed review unit requires re-review. GitHub native APPROVED reviews and CODEOWNERS are not merge prerequisites; the server-side workflow validates artifact provenance and schema but does not authenticate the semantic review itself.
